Create PTP

Enter the information that belongs on the CDI PTP.

Keep it simple: Describe the actual work. Do not worry about hazards, PPE, tools, setup, or cleanup yet — Safety Hub will ask those next.

Crew

Add one person at a time.

Tell Us About Today's Work

Give Safety Hub the facts about today's work. Most answers are quick selections. Categories stay closed when they do not apply.

How this works

You already described the task. Now select what applies. Safety Hub will build the detailed work steps, then the crew lead will put the major activities in the order they will actually happen before hazards and controls are generated.
